title: Fancy Letter
wikitext:
The '''Fancy Letter''' is provided as an objective for {{questlong|Horde|1|Fancy Letter (quest)|Fancy Letter|race=Goblin|class=mage}}.

==Contains==
{{Book|content=
Heya, <name>! The name's Wizette Icewhistle.

I hear you got big brains and a knack for magic just like yours truly. One day you wished so hard you could blow something up, your hands just caught fire! Am I right?

Amazing what you can do if you just think it hard enough. Like this whole operation full of lunk-heads spontaneously bursting into flame. It's so miserable in this hole.

Come pay me a visit and let's talk magic! Teaching you some new spells might distract me from thinking this place on fire.

Oh, don't forget to bring some coin!
}}
